name: KatFile
description: Resolves KatFile links across its mirror domains.

account.secret_hint: Enter your API key as secret, or leave it empty and import your browser cookies from a logged-in premium session instead.

codes.katfile.api_key_required: KatFile link check requires the API key
codes.katfile.captcha_required: KatFile requires solving a captcha for this download, which is not supported
codes.katfile.cookie_session_invalid: KatFile cookie session is not signed in - paste a fresh cookie session from a signed-in browser: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.cookie_session_required: KatFile cookie session is missing or contains no cookies for katfile.biz
codes.katfile.cookie_session_required_for_down: KatFile downloads require a cookie session (browser login); the API key only provides metadata
codes.katfile.cookie_session_unconfirmed: KatFile did not confirm the cookie session either way - the page was neither signed in nor a guest page; try again later: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.download_session_expired: KatFile accepted the API key, but the cookie session downloads run on has expired - sign in at katfile.biz in a browser and paste a fresh cookie session into this account: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.download_wait: KatFile requires waiting {wait_seconds}s before this file can be downloaded
codes.katfile.free_limit_reached: KatFile free download limit reached for this IP address
codes.katfile.no_free_form: KatFile free download form was not found: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.no_free_link: KatFile free download did not yield a file link: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.no_premium_file: KatFile cookie session did not return a premium file: {diagnosis}
codes.katfile.premium_only: KatFile reports this file requires a premium account: {reason}
codes.katfile.session_unconfirmed: cookie session not confirmed - the page was neither signed in nor a guest page
